about_the_game:
Rematch (Original Game Soundtrack) will keep you in the intensity and fun atmosphere of your endless games.
Crafted by Rémi Gallego, it was tailored-made to match each environment's characteristics while being consistent to convey the in-game unique feelings.

Let’s press play again!
